method: Uninstrumented phase CPU, 3 discarded warmups and 9 retained samples in one persistent process per microkernel. Separate per-helper instrumented builds; inclusive helper totals overlap and incur clock overhead. amemory/aresize timings cover runtime allocator calls; libmpdec allocator hooks are measured separately from runtime allocation. Requested runtime bytes count amemory allocations, not every realloc. Managed bytes are live+uncollected, not RSS. macOS maxRSS is bytes, Linux KiB. Phase instrumentation itself perturbs CPU; use phase binary for timing.
